title: Find the bug in a running_total function (hard)
prompt:
This function is supposed to compute a running total but occasionally returns a list one element shorter than the input.

def running_total(nums):
    totals = []
    total = 0
    for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
        total += nums[i]
        totals.append(total)
    return totals

Identify the bug and explain the fix.

metadata.hard_reason: range(len(nums) - 1) silently skips the last element - an easy-to-miss off-by-one inside a range() call.
metadata.notes: Fix: should be range(len(nums)), not range(len(nums) - 1). Graded manually.
